title: [Epic] TUI Overhaul: Full WebSocket Integration
description:
The TUI currently exists as a skeleton with no daemon connectivity. Rewrite it to have full feature parity with the CLI attach command.

**Scope:**
1. Wire TUI to daemon WebSocket (gorilla/websocket connection in Model.Init())
2. Real PTY data flow (input → WS binary, WS binary → lipgloss rendering with ANSI stripping)
3. MRU tab navigation (session entries with MRU counter, create/stop via REST API)
4. Scrollback buffer (1MB ring buffer, auto-scroll + user scroll-lock, View() rendering)
5. Primary control UI (is_primary status, PRIMARY/VIEW indicator, Request Control button)
6. CLI entry point + command mode (refressh tui subcommand, Ctrl+B detach, Ctrl+B scrollback pager, Ctrl+Space request primary, resize handling)

**Technical notes:**
- Use stripansi for ANSI stripping in rendering
- New tabs create sessions via POST /sessions API (default shell for now, clean interface for future command prompt)
- Each tab maps to a session ID; close tab calls DELETE /sessions/{id}
- Bubble Tea handles raw mode internally
- No new deps beyond stripansi (gorilla/websocket already in go.mod)
acceptance_criteria:
1. 'refressh tui' launches the TUI with a tab bar
2. Each tab connects to a real daemon session via WebSocket
3. Terminal output renders correctly in the TUI with proper ANSI stripping
4. Typing in the TUI sends input to the PTY (primary client only)
5. Tab bar shows MRU-ordered tabs with session names
6. Closing a tab stops the session and removes it
7. Scrollback buffer captures all output, user can scroll and search
8. PRIMARY/VIEW ONLY indicator shown in status bar
9. Ctrl+B enters command mode with detach (d), scrollback search (s), and literal Ctrl+B passthrough
10. Ctrl+Space sends request_primary to become primary controller
11. Window resize sends resize control message to daemon
12. All existing tests pass after changes
close_reason: Closed
